get.description: Retrieves a list of AI validation jobs with comprehensive filtering, sorting, and offset-based pagination support. Follows standard product pagination pattern with limit/offset. Includes detailed job information, configuration details, and attack counts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pagination - Number of records to retrieve, default and max value is 100

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset for pagination

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sorting - Field name to sort the validation jobs returned

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order of the validation jobs returned

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filtering
status filters for a specific job status

 - STATUS_UNKNOWN: ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX
ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX

Default unknown state
 - JOB_CREATED: ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX

Job has been created
 - JOB_IN_PROGRESS: ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX

Job is currently in progress
 - JOB_COMPLETED: ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX

Job has been completed successfully
 - JOB_FAILED: ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX

Job has failed

parameters.name: started_after
parameters.description: started_after filters for jobs started after this timestamp

parameters.name: started_before
parameters.description: started_before filters for jobs started before this timestamp

parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of scans to skip before starting to return results

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
Following are the various params to filter the list by:
Name of the artifact which is either a file name or a hugging face repository name.

parameters.name: scan_date
parameters.description: Date at which the scan was created.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
If the scan analyses a file or a repository.

 - NONE_ANALYSIS_TYPE: Default value
 - FILE_ANALYSIS: File analysis

parameters.name: severity

Severity of the threat found during the scan.

 - NONE_SEVERITY: Default value
 - SAFE: Safe, no issues detected
 - LOW: Low severity
 - MEDIUM: Medium severity
 - HIGH: High severity
 - CRITICAL: Critical severity

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Current status of the scan

 - NONE_SCAN_STATUS: Default value
 - PENDING: Scan is pending
 - IN_PROGRESS: Scan is currently in progress
 - COMPLETED: Scan has been completed
 - FAILED: Scan failed
 - CANCELED: Scan was canceled
 - SKIPPED: Scan was skipped
 - DOWNLOADING: Downloading the file

ExternalApiProvider specifies the external API provider to use for the model connection

generativevalidationLanguage.title:
- LANGUAGE_EN: ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX
We use EN as the default value because prior to 2.10 we didn't
have a language option for generative testing, and we implicitly
assumed english was the language.
By making EN the default we ensure these previous versions are compatible,
and will default to using EN correctly.
ENUM_FIELD_NAMES_ZERO_VALUE_END_WITH
English
 - LANGUAGE_JA: Japanese
 - LANGUAGE_FR: French
 - LANGUAGE_DE: German

generativevalidationWebsocketResponseTyp.description:
- WEBSOCKET_RESPONSE_TYPE_CONFIG_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified: behavior determined by response_json_path (see enum description).
 - WEBSOCKET_RESPONSE_TYPE_CONFIG_SINGLE_JSON: Single JSON response with log skipping: Server may send multiple messages including
logs (JSON or text). Non-JSON messages are ignored. Returns the first JSON message
that contains the response_json_path.
generativevalidationWebsocketResponseTyp.title:
WebsocketResponseTypeConfig specifies how the websocket server sends responses.
This is optional - if unspecified, behavior depends on response_json_path:
- If response_json_path is empty: streaming text mode (accumulate all messages)
- If response_json_path is set: single message mode (read and parse one message)
